title: nf-core/methylarray pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline for analysing Illumina EPIC v2.0 DNA methylation IDAT data. It includes sample and probe QC (detection p-values, signal intensities, control probes) with filtering of low-quality samples/probes, followed by background correction and normalization, and downstream differential methylation analysis to identify DMPs and DMRs.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to samplesheet TSV with columns: Sample_Name, Sentrix_ID, Sentrix_Position.

meta_file.description: Sample metadata CSV file with clinical/phenotype information. Must contain required columns: sample_id, group, sex. Optional columns: age, bmi, Plate, and cell composition columns (CD8T, CD4T, NK, Bcell, Mono, Neu, Gran).
meta_file.help_text:
The metadata CSV must contain the following columns:

**Required:**
- `sample_id`: Unique sample identifier matching the samplesheet Sample_Name.
- `group`: Sample group or condition label. The value 'CONTROL' is used as the reference level in differential methylation models.
- `sex`: Biological sex (e.g. 'M' or 'F'), used for sex chromosome QC and model covariates.

**Optional:**
- `age`: Numeric age value, used as a covariate in linear models.
- `bmi`: Numeric BMI value, used as a covariate in linear models.
- `Plate`: Batch or plate identifier used for ComBat batch correction.
- Cell composition columns (estimated or known proportions): `CD8T`, `CD4T`, `NK`, `Bcell`, `Mono`, `Neu`, `Gran`.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

annotation.help_text: Specifies the EPIC v2 manifest annotation version used by the `sesameData` / `IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest` Bioconductor package. The default `20a1.hg38` corresponds to the first release of the EPICv2 array manifest mapped to GRCh38/hg38. Use `20a1.hg19` for hg19 coordinates. Do not change this unless you are working with a specific manifest revision.

genome_build.help_text: Reference genome assembly used for genomic annotation of differentially methylated positions and regions (DMPs/DMRs). `hg38` (GRCh38) is recommended and is the default. `hg19` (GRCh37) is supported for legacy cohorts. This value must be consistent with the `annotation` parameter.

p_det.help_text: Detection p-value threshold used by SeSAMe's pOOBAH (p-values Out-Of-Band Array Hybridisation) method. Probes with a detection p-value above this threshold are considered unreliably detected. The default of `0.05` is the standard nf-core/methylseq recommendation. Lower values (e.g. `0.01`) are more stringent.

fail_sample_fr.description: Maximum fraction of failed probes allowed per sample.
fail_sample_fr.help_text: Samples where more than this fraction of probes fail the `p_det` threshold are flagged and removed from downstream analysis. Default is `0.1` (10%). Increase to be more lenient with sample QC; decrease for stricter quality control.

fail_probe_fr.description: Maximum fraction of failed samples allowed per probe.
fail_probe_fr.help_text: Probes that fail the `p_det` threshold in more than this fraction of samples are removed from the beta-value matrix. Default is `0.1` (10%). Increase to retain more probes; decrease for stricter probe-level QC.

sesame_prep.description: SeSAMe preparation code for preprocessing steps.
sesame_prep.help_text:
A string of single-letter codes controlling SeSAMe's `prepSeSAMe()` preprocessing pipeline. Each letter activates one step in order:
- `Q` – Quality masking (pOOBAH detection p-value masking)
- `C` – Channel inference (Infinium I/II channel correction)
- `D` – Dye bias correction (non-linear dye bias normalisation)
- `P` – Poobah p-value masking (applies pOOBAH mask to betas)
- `B` – Background correction (NOOB background subtraction)

The default `QCDPB` is the recommended preset for EPICv2 arrays. See the [SeSAMe documentation](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/sesame/inst/doc/sesame.html) for all available steps.

filtering_options.title: Probe filtering options
filtering_options.description: Options for filtering probes and SNPs.

do_rmsnpandch.description: Remove probes near SNPs and cross-hybridising probes.
do_rmsnpandch.help_text: When `true`, removes probes that overlap or are near common SNPs (based on `snp_dist_bp` and `snp_maf` thresholds) and probes known to cross-hybridise with off-target genomic regions. This step is strongly recommended to avoid false-positive differential methylation signals driven by genetic variation rather than true epigenetic differences.

snp_dist_bp.description: Distance in bp from SNP to flag a probe for removal.
snp_dist_bp.help_text: Probes within this distance (in base pairs) of a SNP with MAF ≥ `snp_maf` are removed. The default of `2` bp targets SNPs within the last 2 bases of the probe sequence, which have the greatest impact on signal intensity. Set to `0` to only remove probes with a SNP exactly at the CpG site.

snp_maf.description: Minor allele frequency threshold for SNP filtering.
snp_maf.help_text: Only SNPs with a minor allele frequency (MAF) equal to or greater than this value are considered when filtering probes near SNPs. The default `0.01` (1%) removes probes near common SNPs while retaining probes near very rare variants. Set to `0.05` for a more conservative approach.

filter_xy.description: Remove probes on sex chromosomes (chrX, chrY).
filter_xy.help_text: When `true`, probes mapping to chromosome X or Y are excluded from the beta-value matrix before differential methylation analysis. This is recommended for cohorts with mixed sexes to avoid confounding sex-driven methylation differences with the phenotype of interest. Disable (`false`) only if sex-chromosome methylation is the primary study focus.

filter_noncg.description: Remove non-CpG probes (keep only cg* probes).
filter_noncg.help_text: When `true`, removes all probes that are not CpG probes (i.e. probes whose names do not start with `cg`). This includes CH probes (e.g. `ch.*`) and control probes (e.g. `rs.*` SNP probes). Recommended for standard EWAS analyses. Disable only if non-CpG methylation is of interest.

filter_beads.description: Remove probes with insufficient bead counts.
filter_beads.help_text: When `true`, probes are removed if they have fewer than `bead_min` beads in more than `bead_fail_frac` of samples. Applied post-normalisation using `minfi::getNBeads()` on the filtered RGChannelSet. Low bead counts indicate unreliable signal intensity measurements.

bead_min.description: Minimum number of beads required per probe per sample.
bead_min.help_text: Probes with fewer than this many beads in a given sample are considered unreliable for that sample. The default of `3` follows the standard Illumina recommendation. Used together with `bead_fail_frac` to decide whether to remove a probe across all samples.

bead_fail_frac.description: Maximum fraction of samples allowed to have fewer than bead_min beads for a probe to be retained.
bead_fail_frac.help_text: A probe is removed if more than this fraction of samples have fewer than `bead_min` beads at that probe. The default `0.05` (5%) is a conservative threshold consistent with ChAMP and published EWAS pipelines.

do_estimate_cellcomp.description: Estimate blood cell composition using FlowSorted.Blood.EPIC and include estimates as covariates in the differential methylation models.
do_estimate_cellcomp.help_text: When `true`, deconvolutes blood cell composition (CD8T, CD4T, NK, Bcell, Mono, Neu) from the methylation data using the `FlowSorted.Blood.EPIC` Bioconductor reference dataset. Estimated proportions are added as covariates in the limma linear model to control for cell-type heterogeneity — a major confounder in blood-based EWAS. Disable if you are providing known cell counts via the `meta_file` or if working with non-blood tissue.

keep_groups.description: Comma-separated list of sample groups to retain for EWAS/DMR analysis. At least 2 groups required. No default — must always be specified.
keep_groups.help_text: Provide as a comma-separated string: `--keep_groups 'CONTROL,CASE'`. At least 2 groups are required since DMP/DMR analyses need at least one contrast. The value 'CONTROL' is conventionally used as the reference level. All listed groups must be present in the `group` column of the metadata file.

epicv2_remap.description: Remap EPICv2 replicate probes for DMRcate.
epicv2_remap.help_text: The EPICv2 array contains technical replicate probes that target the same CpG site but carry different probe IDs. When `true`, these positional replicates are collapsed to a single representative value using the `posreps_strategy` before running DMRcate. This is required for correct genomic annotation and DMR calling. Set to `false` only if your downstream tool explicitly handles EPICv2 replicates.

posreps_strategy.description: Strategy for handling EPICv2 positional replicates.
posreps_strategy.help_text:
Determines how EPICv2 positional replicate probes (multiple probes targeting the same CpG) are collapsed into a single value:
- `mean`: average beta values across all replicates (recommended — reduces variance)
- `first`: retain only the first probe encountered (alphabetical order)
- `random`: retain a randomly selected replicate

Only used when `epicv2_remap` is `true`.

n_probes_pca.description: Number of most-variable probes used for PCA.
n_probes_pca.help_text: Selects the top `n_probes_pca` most variable CpG probes (by row variance) from the normalised beta-value matrix before running PCA. Reducing this value speeds up computation; increasing it may capture more variance at the cost of runtime.

n_pcs.description: Number of principal components to test for covariate associations.
n_pcs.help_text: Controls how many PCs are retained from PCA and tested for association with each covariate. Increase if you expect meaningful biological/technical signal beyond PC10.

run_covariate_pca.help_text: When `true`, performs principal component analysis (PCA) on the normalised beta-value matrix and correlates principal components with sample metadata covariates (group, sex, age, Plate, cell composition). This step is used to identify major sources of methylation variability and detect batch effects before differential methylation analysis.

run_champ_svd.help_text: When `true`, runs singular value decomposition (SVD) analysis using the ChAMP package to assess the contribution of technical and biological covariates to methylation variance. Produces a heatmap of covariate associations with each SVD component. Useful for detecting batch effects and guiding covariate selection in the differential methylation model.

run_dmp.description: Run differential methylation position (DMP) analysis with limma.
run_dmp.help_text: When `true`, runs a probe-level differential methylation analysis using `limma` on M-values. For each contrast defined by `keep_groups` (case vs. reference CONTROL), outputs a table of differentially methylated positions (DMPs) with log-fold-change, p-values and Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values. Requires at least 2 groups in `keep_groups`.

run_dmr.description: Run differential methylation region (DMR) analysis with DMRcate.
run_dmr.help_text: When `true`, runs region-level differential methylation analysis using the `DMRcate` package. Identifies genomic regions (DMRs) where multiple adjacent CpGs show consistent differential methylation between groups. DMRcate uses a Gaussian kernel smoother on the limma moderated statistics and reports regions with their genomic coordinates, number of CpGs, and statistical significance. Requires `run_dmp` to have been run first.

run_cometh.description: Run coMethDMR consensus DMR analysis alongside DMRcate.
run_cometh.help_text: When `true`, runs coMethDMR in addition to DMRcate and produces a consensus DMR table of regions detected by both methods. Requires `run_dmr` to be `true`.

save_intermediates.description: Save large intermediate RDS objects to the results directory.
save_intermediates.help_text: When `true`, saves intermediate RDS files (`rg0.rds`, `beta_norm.rds`, `beta3.rds`) to the results directory. Disabled by default to reduce storage footprint. Enable if you need to re-run downstream steps without repeating upstream processing.

export_options.title: Export options
export_options.description: Options for exporting final methylation matrices.

export_csv_matrices.description: Export beta and M-value matrices as CSV files.
export_csv_matrices.help_text: When `true`, exports the final filtered and normalised beta-value matrix and M-value matrix as gzip-compressed CSV files to the results directory. These files can be large (hundreds of MB for a full EPICv2 dataset). Disabled by default to save disk space — use `save_final_matrices_rds` for a more compact alternative.

save_final_matrices_rds.description: Save final beta and M-value matrices as RDS files in results.
save_final_matrices_rds.help_text: When `true`, saves the final beta and M-value matrices as serialised R objects (`.rds` files) in the results directory. RDS files are more compact than CSV and can be loaded directly into R for downstream analysis with `readRDS()`. Compression method is controlled by `matrix_rds_compression`.

matrix_rds_compression.description: Compression method for RDS output files.
matrix_rds_compression.help_text:
Compression algorithm used when saving RDS matrix files (only active when `save_final_matrices_rds` is `true`):
- `xz`: best compression ratio, slowest (recommended for archival)
- `gzip`: good balance between size and speed
- `bzip2`: intermediate compression
- `none`: no compression, fastest but largest files

Only affects the output file size; the RDS format and content are identical regardless of compression.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary on failure only.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to pipeline test data.

cofactors.description: Comma-separated list of cofactors to include in the DMP/DMR design matrix.
cofactors.help_text: Standard names (case-insensitive): `sex`, `age`, `bmi`. Any additional name must match a column header in the metadata CSV. Example: `sex,age,bmi,smoking_status`. Cell composition columns (CD8T, CD4T, etc.) are handled separately via `do_estimate_cellcomp`.
